name: Enfuse Solutions Ltd.
summary: Enfuse Solutions Ltd. operates as an information technology consulting and services company, primarily focusing on providing integrated digital solutions globally. The company's core services encompass data management and analytics, including data processing, quality improvement, engineering, annotation, and master data management, alongside e-commerce and digital services such as platform development, content management, and digital marketing. Enfuse Solutions also specializes in machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, offering AI/ML enablement, data tagging, transcription, and annotation services. Furthermore, it provides educational technology solutions, notably proctoring services for secure online assessments, and various managed services including business process management. The company serves a diverse global clientele, ranging from startups to established blue-chip companies, across sectors like Technology, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), Retail, FinTech, Media and Entertainment, Health, and Education. A significant portion of its revenue is generated from export markets, particularly in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions, serving clients in countries such as the USA, Ireland, Netherlands, and Canada.
